<a id="v1-8-2-english"></a>
### English

> A new multifunction panel brings Terminal, SFTP, quick commands and host performance into the workspace, with tools that move between the bottom and right sidebar. File lists scroll continuously, fnOS relays can use changing HTTPS ports, and remote editing, macOS remote desktops and phone dialogs work more reliably.

#### Important fixes

- Renaming an SFTP item to an existing name now reports a conflict and keeps the existing file or folder. Desktop downloads also protect an existing file if its name is taken before the download finishes.
- Remote text files can be opened, saved and backed up on minimal systems such as OpenWrt without Base64 or OpenSSL tools. File-size checks also work without a compatible stat command; failed saves keep the draft for retry.
- macOS XDMCP fixes login-window startup failures and incorrect letter keys by using the active XQuartz display's authorization and keyboard mappings. Startup checks no longer end the session prematurely, and the independent, resizable desktop window is preserved ([#78](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/issues/78)).
- Linux VNC clipboard sharing selects the desktop belonging to the current connection, avoiding interference between separate VNC sessions on the same host.
- Batch command logs keep simultaneous runs separate, identify each host's output and preserve text split across received chunks. Completion is reported after the log has been written.
- Phone dialogs keep confirmation and save buttons reachable when the on-screen keyboard reduces the visible area.
- Background desktop notifications now respect the system-notification setting.

#### Important additions

- The multifunction panel offers flat tabs for quick commands, Terminal, SFTP and host performance. Drag tools between the bottom and right sidebar, reorder or split them, and save layouts. Right sidebar sections collapse independently, and moving tools keeps their sessions.
- Desktop Terminal opens PowerShell on Windows or the system shell on Linux/macOS. It detects installed shells and supports multiple sessions, splits and optional Windows administrator startup. The session list can be resized down to icons.
- Panel SFTP shares the main file manager's actions and follows confirmed directory changes in the active SSH terminal, including macOS. Drag its tab to the main workspace to open a separate file tab while keeping the panel. Linux and macOS host performance starts sampling automatically when visible.
- SFTP and Local Files use continuous scrolling instead of page buttons. Large directories render the visible rows and load more as you scroll.
- Browser users can manage scheduled transfers and folder sync for authorized folders on the device running Terma. These tasks use the server or NAS folders, rather than the phone's local files.
- Forwarding rules and templates support their own group names. The forwarding list can organize rules by these groups and start or stop a group together.
- fnOS accepts trusted relay domains or IPs without a scheme or port, so changing HTTPS relay ports keep working. Login remains required; existing complete HTTPS entries keep their exact port restriction. Settings → Security shows the active list and allows entries to be removed.

#### Other improvements

- File navigation, search, forwarding rules and logs use tighter spacing. Action areas match the activity bar, buttons wrap to fit, and shared dialogs support dragging and resizing.
- SFTP shows account names for numeric owner and group IDs when available, and offers remote account choices when changing ownership. Missing SFTP support produces a clearer explanation.
- Desktop startup prepares and paints its progress window before loading services, and keeps it visible until the main window appears, reducing blank flashes. The start page provides clearer actions, and View connections expands a collapsed connection area.
- Phone workspace shortcuts use aligned flat icons, and a single workspace no longer needs a group bar. Blocked sign-ins explain the actual origin difference; fnOS settings explain how to keep, clear or reset saved values.
- FTP directory parsing handles unexpected server fields more reliably, and SVG-to-PDF conversion uses updated content filtering.

<a id="v1-8-2-zh"></a>
### 简体中文

> 新增多功能面板，将终端、SFTP、快捷命令和主机性能集中在工作区，工具可以在底部和右侧栏之间移动。文件列表改为连续滚动，飞牛中继支持变化的 HTTPS 端口，同时改善远程编辑、macOS 远程桌面和手机弹窗体验。

#### 重要修复

- SFTP 重命名遇到已有名称时提示冲突，保留已有文件和文件夹。桌面下载完成前若目标名称被其他文件占用，也会保护已有文件。
- OpenWrt 等精简系统无需安装 Base64 或 OpenSSL 工具即可打开、保存远端文本及保存前备份；缺少兼容的 stat 命令时也能检查文件大小，保存失败时保留草稿以便重试。
- macOS XDMCP 使用当前 XQuartz 显示的授权与键盘映射，修复登录窗口启动失败、字母键输入错误的问题；启动检查不再导致会话提前结束，并保留独立、可调整大小的桌面窗口（[#78](https://github.com/zmide/Terma/issues/78)）。
- Linux VNC 剪贴板共享使用当前连接对应的桌面，避免同一主机上的多个 VNC 会话相互干扰。
- 批量命令同时执行时分别保存日志，标明各主机输出，保留分段接收的完整文本；日志写入完成后才报告任务结束。
- 手机软键盘缩小可见区域时，弹窗中的确认和保存按钮仍可触达。
- 后台桌面通知遵守系统通知开关设置。

#### 重要新增

- 多功能面板提供快捷命令、终端、SFTP 和主机性能的扁平标签。工具可在底部和右侧栏之间拖动、排序、分屏并保存布局；右侧各区可独立收起，移动工具时保留会话。
- 桌面端终端默认打开 Windows PowerShell 或 Linux／macOS 系统 Shell，检测本机已安装的 Shell，支持多会话、拆分及可选的 Windows 管理员启动；实例列表可调整宽度并缩到仅显示图标。
- 面板 SFTP 复用主文件管理器的操作，跟随当前 SSH 终端确认的目录变化，支持 macOS；拖到主工作区可另开文件标签并保留面板。Linux 和 macOS 主机性能在可见时自动采样。
- SFTP 和本地文件取消翻页按钮，改为连续滚动；大目录只渲染可见行，随滚动加载更多项目。
- 浏览器可管理 Terma 所在设备授权目录的定时传输和文件夹同步；任务操作服务器或 NAS 目录，不是手机本地文件。
- 转发规则与模板支持独立分组名，转发列表可按这些分组展示，并统一启动或停止分组。
- 飞牛可只填写可信中继的域名或 IP，无需协议和端口，自动适配 HTTPS 中继端口变化；仍需登录，已有完整 HTTPS 地址保留精确端口限制。“设置 → 安全”显示实际列表并支持移除授权。

#### 其他优化

- 文件导航、搜索、转发规则和日志界面更加紧凑，操作区与活动栏配色统一，按钮按空间换行；通用弹窗支持拖动和调整大小。
- SFTP 可为数字形式的所有者和用户组显示对应名称，修改所有者时可选择远端账号；远端缺少 SFTP 支持时给出更清楚的说明。
- 桌面启动时先准备并绘制进度窗口，再加载服务，主窗口显示后才移除进度窗口，减少空白闪烁；开始使用页面入口更清晰，“查看连接”可展开已收起的连接区。
- 手机工作区快捷图标扁平对齐，只有一个工作区时隐藏组栏；登录受阻时说明实际来源差异，飞牛设置说明如何保留、清空或重置已有值。
- FTP 目录解析更好地处理服务器返回的异常字段，SVG 转 PDF 使用更新的内容过滤。
